title: MPOLYGON fill-color name retained-byte owner fast slice
scope: Charge retained DXF group-430 MPOLYGON fillColorName through the existing entity lease
Preserve field-byte ownership across copy, move, assignment, reset, and parser refusal
Use only the owning fast hardening target and selector

method.kind: Implement one confirmed retained-string accounting gap and add generated in-memory direct-parser controls
method.limitations: Direct parser-method tests cover retained-byte admission and lifetime but not the full MPOLYGON read callback, renderer, DWG codec, graph semantics, or binary ABI compatibility.

implementation.productionChange: DRW_MPolygon::parseCode now routes group 430 through replaceDxfRetainedStringField on the shared entity lease using a private per-field byte counter. Copy construction/assignment copy the counter with the string; default move operations transfer the base lease and field state; resetDwgState clears the counter and value.
testCoverage: Measure exact transient replacement peak and exact-cap success
One-byte-under refusal preserves the old field value and retained charge
Reader teardown leaves the logical field charged
Copy construction and assignment preserve the field lease
Move construction and assignment transfer the field lease
Final reset releases the retained bytes
implementation.abiNote: Private state changes public DRW_MPolygon object layout; downstream consumers must rebuild and binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

results.initialTestAttempt: The initial assertion expected transient replacement admission to equal only final live-string bytes. It failed, correctly exposing reserve-before-release peak behavior. The test was corrected to measure and assert the transient peak; production behavior was unchanged by this test correction.
